summary:
- Block ads and trackers using Brave's adblock engine and list catalog, updated daily in the background.
- Switch to full uBlock Origin in WebView2 with protection against cookie banners, app prompts, and link tracking.
- Upgrade existing profiles automatically from uBlock Origin Lite to full uBlock Origin.
- Recover interrupted YouTube watch pages automatically instead of stalling on skeleton placeholders.
- Skip re-indexing installed extensions on startup and tab creation.
- Show "Veluno is up to date" as an expiring toast instead of keeping it pinned in the sidebar.
- Separate sidebar feedback rows with clean borders and replace tab restore with a compact Undo button.
